about: The items of the UHC DLL feature minUIStats (the key minUIStats in a Startup .cfg), which fills rows of the minimised selection panel from data\uhc\minuirows.xml: <row gadget=... item=... label=...> or text="LOS: {los}|Speed: {speed}" (each part between | shows only when its items have a value; the parts left are joined by three spaces), types= to show a row only for units of those types, <bigPanelRows gadget="...%d" first=N skip=...> for the big panel's rows. Each item is also a {uhc...} text for any formatText gadget. What each reads and when it has a value, as the feature does it (no code here). 'needs': other keys of the DLL the item depends on; 'state': what a unit must be doing for it to have a value; 'live': the game changes it as it plays (techs, auras), so offline it is the proto's base value.
